{"path": "/results/6_Nov_Optimised/claude_45/tool_calling/melting/subtask_true/level_1/brief/silicon_melting_1_subtask_melting_trial_0/melting.in", "content": "# Silicon NPT Melting Simulation
# Stillinger-Weber potential

# Initialization
units metal
atom_style full
boundary p p p

# Read structure
read_data /results/6_Nov_Optimised/claude_45/tool_calling/melting/subtask_true/level_1/brief/silicon_melting_1_subtask_structure_retrieval_trial_0/structure.data

# Define potential
pair_style sw
pair_coeff * * /potentials/SW/Si.sw Si

# Neighbor settings
neighbor 2.0 bin
neigh_modify delay 0 every 1 check yes

# Timestep
timestep 0.001

# Compute temperature and pressure
compute myTemp all temp
compute myPress all pressure myTemp

# NPT heating from 300K to 2500K at 2.2 K/ps
# Temperature change: 2200K, Rate: 2.2 K/ps, Time: 1000 ps = 1,000,000 steps
variable temp_start equal 300.0
variable temp_end equal 2500.0
variable temp_ramp equal ramp(${temp_start},${temp_end})

# Set up NPT ensemble with Nose-Hoover thermostat and barostat
fix npt_heat all npt temp ${temp_start} ${temp_end} $(100.0*dt) iso 0.0 0.0 $(1000.0*dt)

# Trajectory output
dump traj all custom 1000 /results/6_Nov_Optimised/claude_45/tool_calling/melting/subtask_true/level_1/brief/silicon_melting_1_subtask_melting_trial_0/trajectory.lammpstrj id type x y z

# Thermo output
thermo 1000
thermo_style custom step temp press vol density pe ke etotal

# Run heating
run 1000000

# Write final structure
write_data /results/6_Nov_Optimised/claude_45/tool_calling/melting/subtask_true/level_1/brief/silicon_melting_1_subtask_melting_trial_0/final_structure.data

print "Simulation completed"
"}
